operators.name: baddbmm_forward
semantics: Computes output = beta * bias + alpha * (mat1 @ mat2) using batch matrix multiplication over batch dimension.
Broadcasting follows torch.baddbmm: bias shape must be broadcastable to [batch, M, N]; in this task bias shape equals [batch, M, N].
Alpha and beta are scalars defaulting to 1.0, matching reference torch.baddbmm defaults.
Inputs may have non-contiguous strides; the implementation should handle them (e.g., via cuBLAS strided batched GEMM or explicit contiguous conversion).
Returns a freshly allocated tensor with shape [batch, M, N] and dtype float32 on the same CUDA device as inputs.
Performs batched matrix multiplication: for each batch b, out[b] = bias[b] + mat1[b] @ mat2[b].
All tensors are float32 on CUDA; result dtype is float32.
